name: Optical Material Accents
description: Composable light-response treatments on supplied forms; these are artistic descriptions, not physical simulations.
author: NidAll

styles.name: Stress-color interference
styles.description: Localized interference bands follow existing translucent forms.

clauses.text: Introduce restrained interference colors within existing translucent regions, leaving specified opaque object colors intact
Let the colored bands follow existing curvature and thickness cues

styles.name: Dichroic edge shift
styles.description: A thin-film hue split is confined to oblique highlights.

clauses.text: Split only grazing highlights into a restrained paired hue shift
Keep broad front-facing areas neutral so the color change reads as angular reflection
tags: neutral frontal and shifting grazing reflection

styles.name: Index-matched quiet
styles.description: Low-contrast internal boundaries retain the supplied outer silhouette.

clauses.text: Reduce internal surface contrast in existing translucent materials while retaining all required contours
Keep identifying marks and supplied lettering legible through the softened internal boundaries

styles.name: Retroreflective return
styles.description: A compact near-view highlight reads as light returning toward the observer.

clauses.text: Concentrate a compact returned-light highlight on appropriate existing reflective areas
Resolve fine beadlike sparkle only inside that highlight, without adding objects

styles.name: Subsurface edge transmission
styles.description: Thin existing edges carry soft transmitted illumination.

clauses.text: Let light spread softly through thin edges of appropriate supplied materials
Keep thick interior forms opaque and preserve their identifying surface marks
tags: opaque thick forms with preserved surface marks

styles.name: Frosted rim scatter
styles.description: Roughened edge highlights soften without an overall image blur.

clauses.text: Spread bright rim highlights over a narrow roughened edge region
Keep broad existing surfaces clear while edge grain remains fine and irregular
tags: clear broad surfaces and fine edge grain

styles.name: Fluorescent surface spill
styles.description: Small emissive-looking regions lift adjacent tones with controlled falloff.

clauses.text: Give selected existing bright regions a soft re-emission-like spill onto immediately adjacent surfaces
Keep the spill narrow enough that supplied markings and lettering remain separate
tags: narrow spill with separate supplied markings

styles.name: Anisotropic highlight streak
styles.description: Long highlights follow one supplied material direction.

clauses.text: Stretch local specular highlights along a consistent direction on each existing surface
Use fine aligned surface striations without changing the supplied silhouette
